# lumis-tree-sitter

The [tree-sitter](https://crates.io/crates/tree-sitter) 0.27.1 crate with the patches
below applied, published so Lumis can ship them. Every file except
`upstream.toml`, `patches/` and `CHANGELOG.md` is generated from that release and
those patches; nothing here is edited by hand.

Use it through a renamed dependency so code keeps saying `tree_sitter`:

```toml
tree-sitter = { package = "lumis-tree-sitter", version = "…" }
```

## What differs from tree-sitter 0.27.1

### fix(lib): only match the whole name `ERROR` in `ts_language_symbol_for_name`

`patches/0001-only-match-the-whole-name-error.patch`

`ts_language_symbol_for_name` compared named lookups against "ERROR"
using the length of the name being looked up, so any prefix of "ERROR",
including the empty string, resolved to the error symbol. Queries like
`(ERR)` compiled as `(ERROR)` instead of failing with a node type error,
and `Language::id_for_node_kind("ERR", true)` returned the error symbol
instead of 0.

Backport of tree-sitter/tree-sitter@e9930e0915685efb98a9d325b8f23dfdb9e99559,
released after 0.27.1. Drop it when the pin moves past it.

### fix(wasm): copy all supertype map entries

`patches/0002-copy-all-wasm-supertype-map-entries.patch`

A parser loaded from Wasm lost supertype map entries: the entries array
was sized from the supertype count rather than from the greatest slice
end, so supertype queries matched less than the same grammar compiled
natively. Size it from the greatest slice end, independently of
supertype symbol IDs.

Backport of tree-sitter/tree-sitter@fbfb07e93de82e12784cd0f646e291b8f2e4126e
(tree-sitter/tree-sitter#6035), released after 0.27.1. Drop it when the
pin moves past it.

### Every exported C symbol is prefixed with `lumis_`

Applied last, so it covers what the patches add. `src/lumis_prefix.h` renames
279 names: every function and variable the library defines with external
linkage, plus a few static ones a macro hides from the source reader, which renaming
does not affect. The Rust bindings import them under the new names. The crate's `links` key is
`lumis-tree-sitter`, so it builds and links beside upstream `tree-sitter` instead of
being rejected by Cargo, and neither one calls the other's C code.

Wasmtime is the exception: its C API crate declares `links = "wasmtime-c-api"`, so
a project that also enables upstream's `wasm` feature resolves only when both pin
the same Wasmtime major. The pin follows the newest tree-sitter release to keep
that true.

The optional `bindgen` build dependency is removed, because bindings generated at
build time would import the unprefixed names.

Parsers are unaffected: a Wasm parser's imports and exports are matched by name
strings, not by these symbols, so the same parser loads in both libraries.
